components.purpose: Opening banner — a hero/background section whose Heading, Description, CTAs, and background can be swapped per audience via its 'Personalized Hero Items' nested list, so the banner adapts to the visitor's detected industry.
Logo row — pulls company/customer logos from the shared Companies list and shows personalized items per audience when a match is available, so the logo row adapts to the visitor's industry.
Feature cards — displays the grid of Feature Items (heading, subheading, configurable columns) to showcase the product's features at the bottom of the page.
